Real money, not arbitrary scores.
home.pmeDescription: Every valuation on ValuePerFan represents what a brand would spend on paid media campaigns to achieve the same results that organic content delivers. <bold>Not a guess. Not a score. The real market value.</bold>
home.vpfDescription: Total value divided by every 1,000 followers. This simple metric reveals who generates the most value per follower — regardless of size. <bold>A creator with 10,000 engaged followers can rank above a celebrity with millions.</bold>
home.disclaimer: All valuations are estimates based on public data and PME (Paid Media Equivalence) proprietary methodology.
home.howItWorksStep1: We measure the organic reach and engagement of every post published during the month.
home.howItWorksStep2: Using Paid Media Equivalence, we estimate the real market value — what a brand would pay to achieve the same results through ads.
home.howItWorksStep3: Dividing total value by followers reveals who generates the most value per fan — regardless of audience size. Accounts are also ranked by total value, so you can explore both perspectives.
home.whyVpfDescription: Raw follower counts don't tell you who's valuable. A creator with 50K engaged fans can generate more real economic value than an account with millions of passive followers. Value Per Fan normalizes economic value by audience size, creating a democratic ranking where content quality matters more than fame.
home.faq1Q: What is a social media value calculator?
home.faq1A: A social media value calculator estimates the real economic value of a social media account — what brands would pay in advertising to achieve the same reach and engagement that organic content delivers. ValuePerFan uses Paid Media Equivalence (PME) to calculate this value for any Instagram or TikTok account, providing valuations in dollars based on real advertising market data.
home.faq2A: Paid Media Equivalence (PME) is a methodology that calculates the earned media value of organic social media content. It measures what a brand would need to spend on paid advertising (Instagram Ads, TikTok Ads) to achieve the same impressions, reach, and engagement that organic content delivers. Unlike arbitrary scores, PME is grounded in real advertising market rates — the same methodology used by professional sports teams and entertainment companies.
home.faq3Q: How is the value of a social media account calculated?
home.faq3A: We analyze all content published during the month — posts, reels, and videos. For each piece of content, we measure organic reach, impressions, and engagement. Using current advertising market rates (CPM and CPE), we calculate the Paid Media Equivalence: the total cost of replicating those results through paid ads. This gives every account a concrete economic value in dollars.
home.faq4A: Value Per Fan divides the total economic value by every 1,000 followers (following the CPM convention). This normalization reveals which accounts generate the most value per follower, regardless of audience size. A creator with 50,000 engaged fans can rank above a celebrity with millions of passive followers — making it a democratic metric where content quality matters more than fame.
home.faq5Q: How much is an Instagram or TikTok account worth?
home.faq5A: The value depends on the content's organic performance — reach, impressions, and engagement during the analyzed month. Use our social media value calculator to check any account instantly. Enter a handle and see the total Paid Media Equivalence value plus the Value Per Fan ranking. We currently cover over 8,000 Instagram and TikTok accounts across 128+ countries.
home.faq6Q: How often is the data updated?
home.faq6A: We update all valuations at the end of each month, reflecting the previous month's content performance. The data period is shown on every page, so you always know exactly which month the valuations represent.

methodology.metaTitle: Paid Media Equivalence (PME) Methodology — How We Calculate Social Media Value
methodology.metaDescription: Learn how ValuePerFan calculates the real economic value of social media accounts using Paid Media Equivalence (PME) — the methodology used across professional sports and entertainment.
methodology.heading: How we calculate Social Media Value
methodology.introText: Every valuation on ValuePerFan is calculated using Paid Media Equivalence (PME) — a methodology that measures the earned media value of organic social media content by answering one question: what would a brand pay in paid advertising to achieve the same results?
methodology.step1Text: We analyze all content published by an account during the month — posts, reels, and videos. For each piece of content, we measure organic reach, impressions, and engagement (likes, comments, shares).
methodology.step2Text: Each content metric is matched against current advertising market rates for the same platform. What would it cost to buy the same number of impressions? The same reach? The same engagement? We use real CPM (cost per thousand) and CPE (cost per engagement) rates from the advertising market.
methodology.step3Text: The total Paid Media Equivalence (PME) value represents what a brand would need to spend on paid media campaigns to achieve the same results that this account delivers organically. This is how we calculate media value: a concrete, defensible number grounded in real market data — not an arbitrary score.
methodology.vpfText: Value Per Fan divides the total Paid Media Equivalence (PME) value by every 1,000 followers (following the CPM convention). This normalization reveals who generates the most economic value per follower — regardless of audience size. A micro-influencer with highly engaged followers can rank above a celebrity with millions of passive followers.
methodology.whyDifferentTitle: Why Paid Media Equivalence (PME) is different
methodology.whyDifferentText: Most social media valuation tools use arbitrary scoring algorithms or simple follower-based multipliers. Paid Media Equivalence (PME) is different because it's grounded in real advertising market data — the same methodology used by professional sports teams, leagues, and entertainment companies to value their social media portfolios.
methodology.trustedTitle: Trusted across professional sports and entertainment
methodology.trustedText: The Paid Media Equivalence methodology behind ValuePerFan is developed by <link>Horizm</link>, the AI-powered platform trusted by professional sports teams, leagues, and entertainment companies worldwide to value their digital partnerships.
methodology.limitation1: Valuations are based on public data only. Private metrics (Stories views, DM interactions) are not included.
methodology.limitation2: Instagram Stories are excluded due to their ephemeral nature — they cannot be reliably captured and measured.
methodology.limitation3: Market rates fluctuate. Valuations represent a snapshot based on current advertising rates.
methodology.limitation4: Paid Media Equivalence (PME) measures economic equivalence, not actual revenue. It represents what the content is worth in market terms, not what the creator earns.
methodology.ctaText: Try our social media value calculator to see the Paid Media Equivalence (PME) valuation of any account.
